controller_policy: all five previous controller policies imported unchanged; extra fresh_current_response fits only current observed PI prefix as a separate shadow comparator
retrieval: two typed TSST queries per current observable device: latest accepted experience and latest accepted ARX experience if distinct; otherwise second query is broad context. Bookkeeping selects identity only; control models originate exclusively in authenticated responses.
candidate_fairness: one captured actual TSST union plus observed ODVL supplied to all six arms; local physical qualification and present PI prefix apply before memory use
residual_semantics: effective response coefficients are estimates from simulated observed signals, not direct physical truth; old fit uncertainty and current-prefix rejection remain unchanged

forecast_evaluation.method: after the episode, reconstruct each accepted decision prediction using only its observed-past fit and frozen chosen frequencies/weights, then compare to later measured reference; future measurements enter evaluation only
forecast_evaluation.not_actuator_prediction: gain correction changes FF, not the disturbance forecast; these effects are reported separately

fresh_reference: fully memory-free comparator: online FF plus current-prefix calibration; never uses utility decisions or feeds shared memory; fit uses only376observations with actual current episode identity

network.cache_per_episode: two wrappers around the same two persistent HTTP clients, validators fixed to confirmed versions and index; capture, refresh, measure300gets, compute, await before write
network.http_overlap: new passive request/response hooks distinguish a genuinely in-flight HTTP call from pacing/pending state; no claim if strict overlap proof is absent

limitations: four dependent sequential episodes, descriptive only
simulated signals and plant, no hardware result
typed access addresses specific accepted memories; no claim of exhaustive or optimal semantic search
current-prefix calibration and Cloud memory are distinct evidence sources
no tuning after these four outcomes
publication_status: Sanitized protocol excerpt, not an original Cloud receipt
display_numbering: Display episodes45..48 correspond to source indices44..47.
